case_id_definition: EKPO.EBELN (Purchase Order Document Number) + EKPO.EBELP (Purchase Order Line Item Number)

activity_definitions.name: Create Purchase Order Item
activity_definitions.trigger_condition: Creation of purchase order item in EKPO table

activity_definitions.name: Approve Purchase Order Item
activity_definitions.trigger_condition: Release indicator update in EKKO or CDHDR tracking

activity_definitions.name: Receive Goods
activity_definitions.trigger_condition: Post goods receipt in MSEG table with transaction type 101

activity_definitions.name: Receive Invoice
activity_definitions.trigger_condition: Register vendor invoice in RBKP / RSEG tables

activity_definitions.name: Pay Invoice
activity_definitions.trigger_condition: Clear payment in BSAK / BKPF financial ledger

kpis.name: PO-to-GR Throughput Time
kpis.description: Time elapsed between creating PO item and receiving goods
kpis.calculation_idea: AVG(Timestamp(Receive Goods) - Timestamp(Create Purchase Order Item))

kpis.name: Touchless PO Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of POs that did not require manual approval changes
kpis.calculation_idea: COUNT(cases with no changes) / Total PO Cases

kpis.name: Invoice Verification Time
kpis.description: Time to post an invoice since goods receipt

business_filters.name: Maverick Buying
business_filters.rule: Invoice posting occurs before PO creation date

acceptance_rules: Case ID must never be null
Activities must follow sequential timestamps (Create PO <= Receive Goods <= Receive Invoice <= Clear Payment)
Goods receipt must link to the purchase order reference (MSEG.EBELN = EKPO.EBELN)
